title: A Multi-Agent System for IPMSM Design Optimization via an FEA-AI Hybrid Approach
title_zh: 基于 FEA-AI 混合方法的 IPMSM 设计优化多智能体系统
abstract_en: Interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) design requires balancing conflicting objectives and multi-physics constraints, while modern optimization workflows face three bottlenecks: manual problem setup, high finite element analysis (FEA) cost, and unreliable surrogate-based search in sparse or out-of-distribution regions. To address these limitations, we propose an end-to-end automated IPMSM design optimization framework that integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for structured problem definition with an uncertainty-aware FEA-AI hybrid optimization pipeline. A Design agent, connected to a motor textbook through RAG, provides domain-knowledge-based options and engineering tips, and compiles an optimization card and a design-of-experiments plan for AI-model training. A Training agent automates electromagnetic FEA, records geometry-validation and solver-failure logs, analyzes failed geometries using ANOVA-based data analysis and LLM reasoning, and invokes a Design Sampling agent to redefine the design space and generate additional samples. An Optimization agent performs GA-based search with uncertainty-driven switching: low-uncertainty candidates are evaluated by AI-surrogate inference, whereas high-uncertainty and reliability-critical Pareto-front or top-K candidates are corrected by high-fidelity FEA and reused for iterative retraining. The framework converts manual, experience-dependent configuration into a reproducible workflow that balances computational cost and prediction reliability. Experimental results under a matched high-fidelity FEA budget show that the proposed hybrid approach achieves better objective performance while maintaining low and further reducible predictive uncertainty, outperforming FEA-only search, which is limited by early budget exhaustion, and AI-only search, which converges to a low-confidence optimum.
abstract_zh: 针对 Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor（IPMSM）设计中多目标冲突、多物理约束、人工建模成本高、Finite Element Analysis（FEA）计算昂贵以及稀疏或分布外区域中 surrogate model 搜索不可靠等问题，本文提出一个端到端自动化 IPMSM 设计优化框架。该框架结合 Retrieval-Augmented Generation（RAG）进行结构化问题定义，并引入不确定性感知的 FEA-AI 混合优化流程。Design agent 通过 RAG 连接电机教材，提供领域知识选项和工程建议，生成 optimization card 与 Design of Experiments（DoE）计划；Training agent 自动执行电磁 FEA，记录几何校验与求解失败日志，并利用 ANOVA 数据分析和 LLM 推理诊断失败几何，再调用 Design Sampling agent 重定义设计空间并补充样本；Optimization agent 采用 Genetic Algorithm（GA）搜索，并根据预测不确定性切换评估方式：低不确定性候选由 AI surrogate 推理，高不确定性及 Pareto-front 或 top-K 等可靠性关键候选由高保真 FEA 修正，并回流用于迭代重训练。实验表明，在相同高保真 FEA 预算下，该混合方法相比 FEA-only 搜索和 AI-only 搜索获得更好的目标性能，并保持较低且可进一步降低的预测不确定性。
key_points_zh: 提出一个面向 IPMSM 设计的端到端多智能体优化框架，将 RAG、LLM 推理、FEA 与 AI surrogate 集成到可复现工作流中。
Design agent 借助电机教材 RAG 自动完成问题结构化、设计选项推荐、工程提示、optimization card 和 DoE 采样计划生成。
Training agent 自动运行电磁 FEA，并通过失败日志、ANOVA 分析和 LLM 推理识别无效几何原因，驱动 Design Sampling agent 动态调整设计空间。
Optimization agent 使用 GA 搜索，并采用不确定性感知策略：低风险样本走 AI surrogate，高不确定性或 Pareto/top-K 关键样本走高保真 FEA 校正。
在匹配的 FEA 预算下，FEA-AI 混合方法优于 FEA-only 与 AI-only：前者预算过早耗尽，后者易收敛到低置信度最优解。

llm_assessment.comment: A domain-specific engineering optimization workflow with some agent orchestration and retraining loops, but its lasting value is mostly outside general agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项领域特定的工程优化工作，包含一定智能体编排和再训练循环，但其长期价值主要不在通用智能体 harness 演进上。
